description: Reference machine for the DESIGN 11.4 benchmark gate (tests/benchmark_gate.rs). Thresholds are asserted only when the current machine matches `fingerprint` (CPU model + OS pretty name); elsewhere the gate prints measurements informationally.

enforced.note: DESIGN 11.4 defines warm as the second run immediately after warming the on-disk cache. The benchmark asserts that cold is a cache miss, creates cache-v1.sqlite3, and warm is a dependency-validated cache hit before enforcing this threshold.

measured.aggregation: median of three consecutive benchmark processes

conditions: Median of three consecutive invocations on the reference machine using the default Rayon worker pool. In each process the deterministic 20-file fixture is written to an isolated temporary project before timing, so its source contents are already in the OS page cache. Cold is the first in-process check() with .manim-lint-cache absent and asserts CacheStatus::Miss plus database creation. Warm is the immediately following identical check() and asserts CacheStatus::Hit. Peak RSS is VmHWM of the test process, covering both runs.
